_meta.tracker_note: Real Render-log extracts for staging request IDs ae9b2726 and 133d0107 were not available at fixture build time. Samples below mirror the documented offending phrases verbatim from the brief. Replace with real captures when access is restored.

schema.expectations: free-form notes on what sanitisation must / must not do

offending.text: Option A wins with a 0.862 probability of reaching the goal.
offending.expectations: decimal converted to '86%'; surrounding clause unchanged

offending.text: The probability of success is around 0.74 across both runs.
offending.expectations: rewrite to '... probability is 74%' or 'probability of 74%'; do not introduce double tokens

offending.text: Likelihood is 0.55 that the new factor flips the ranking.
offending.expectations: rewrite '0.55' to '55%' inside the likelihood clause

offending.text: There is a chance of 0.12 that the risk fires before Q3.
offending.expectations: rewrite '0.12' to '12%' inside the chance clause
rewrite to 'Win probability 91% for Option B.'

offending.text: Goal probability = 0.62 in the latest run.
offending.expectations: rewrite to 'Goal probability 62% in the latest run.'

offending.text: The link from Option A to the outcome carries a strength of 0.55.
offending.expectations: structural phrase suppressed; sentence ends 'is causally linked.'

offending.text: We see edge strength of 0.30 from Marketing Spend to Revenue.
offending.expectations: structural phrase suppressed; replaced with 'this causal link'

offending.text: The causal strength value of 0.42 is moderate.
We measured a sensitivity value of 1.0 for the headline driver.
offending.expectations: rewritten to 'a very strong sensitivity signal'

offending.text: The driver shows sensitivity of -0.40 in the second run.

legitimate.text: This option has an 86% chance of reaching the goal.
legitimate.expectations: unchanged: percentage already in display form

legitimate.text: The forecast carries a moderate band (0.95 confidence interval) across runs.
legitimate.expectations: unchanged: parenthetical CI must not be rewritten

legitimate.text: The win-rate moved by -0.40 percentage points after the change.
legitimate.expectations: unchanged: delta context, not a sensitivity

legitimate.text: Updated to version 0.10.0 of the schemas package.
legitimate.expectations: unchanged: version triplet is not a probability

legitimate.text: Factor fac_churn_0.5 was extracted from the brief.
The exists_probability field is preserved on every edge.
legitimate.expectations: unchanged: 'exists_probability' is a field name not user-facing prose

legitimate.text: The response_hash: 4da7e62f208e was attached to the turn.
legitimate.expectations: unchanged: hash content has no decimals

legitimate.text: The probability variance is 0.12 across runs.
legitimate.expectations: unchanged: variance is a magnitude statistic, not a probability value

legitimate.text: The likelihood ratio is 0.42 between scenarios.
legitimate.expectations: unchanged: ratio is a ratio, not a [0,1] probability

legitimate.text: The probability calibration error is 0.12 in the latest run.
legitimate.expectations: unchanged: calibration error is a diagnostic metric

legitimate.text: The probability gap of 0.08 narrowed after the change.
legitimate.expectations: unchanged: gap is a delta / diagnostic, not a probability

legitimate.text: The likelihood divergence is 0.55 across models.
legitimate.expectations: unchanged: divergence is a diagnostic statistic

legitimate.text: The annual budget is £1.50 million for the project.
legitimate.expectations: unchanged: currency value, not a probability/sensitivity (Area B amendment 2 — legitimate factual value must not be failed)

legitimate.text: Revenue grew 1.5x in the first year after launch.
legitimate.expectations: unchanged: multiplier, not a normalised [0,1] value

legitimate.text: There is a 0.5% processing fee on each transaction.
legitimate.expectations: unchanged: already a displayed percentage, not a raw normalised decimal

legitimate.text: Set the discount rate to 0.08 in the financial model.
legitimate.expectations: unchanged: factual/structured value stated in prose with no probability/sensitivity context (Area B amendment 2)
